stories.title: Beyond the walls: Long Street gallery reimagines the art experience
stories.summary: Cape Town's Signature Art Gallery is reimagining the art experience on Long Street. It combines visual art with live music, fashion, and design, creating opportunities for artists.
stories.angle: This initiative fosters artistic growth and provides new platforms for creators.
